# issue: 2923
# what: release history for the PIX virtual-register
#       numbering symptom. triage.py bisect cannot drive
#       this repro (it is not a dxc invocation), so this is
#       a hand-run matrix, produced by history-2923.py.
# driver: run-2923.cmd <shader> <opt>, with PIX_DXC and
#         PIX_DLL pointed at each release's dxc.exe and
#         dxcompiler.dll
# cells: <match.json predicate>/<PixTest assertions>
#        the control columns must read no-match. `test-FAILS`
#        on a control column is NOT the symptom -- see notes.md.
#
